name: frappe-errors-permissions
description: Use when debugging or handling permission errors in Frappe/ERPNext. Prevents broken document access from throwing in permission hooks. Covers PermissionError (403), has_permission hook failures, User Permission restricting too much or too little, perm_level blocking field access, System Manager bypass not working, Guest access denied, sharing permissions not applying, permission_query_conditions breaking get_list, owner-based permissions confusion, Apply User Permission checkbox behavior, and the permission debug workflow using frappe.permissions.get_doc_permissions. Keywords: PermissionError, has_permission, permission_query_conditions,, permission denied, cannot access, user blocked, sharing not working, role not enough. User Permission, perm_level, sharing, guest access, owner permission.
